Formula: Sum of all active subscription amounts
Why_It_Matters: Foundation metric. Everything else is calculated from MRR.
How_To_Improve: Reduce churn + increase upgrades + acquire new customers

Why_It_Matters: Useful for fundraising and annual planning. MRR × 12.
Anti_Pattern: Projecting ARR from a single good month

Formula: Total Marketing Spend / New Customers Acquired
Why_It_Matters: How much it costs to get one paying customer. Must be lower than LTV.
How_To_Improve: Optimize conversion funnel. Focus on organic channels. Reduce spend on low-performing channels.
Anti_Pattern: Including organic users in CAC calculation (skews low)

Why_It_Matters: Total revenue you'll earn from one customer over their lifetime.
How_To_Improve: Reduce churn (biggest lever). Increase ARPU via upsell. Add retention features.
Anti_Pattern: Calculating LTV from < 3 months of data

Why_It_Matters: The golden ratio. > 3:1 = healthy business. < 1:1 = losing money per customer.
How_To_Improve: Increase LTV (reduce churn) OR decrease CAC (better conversion).

Formula: Total Monthly Expenses - Total Monthly Revenue
Why_It_Matters: How fast you're spending cash. Revenue minus expenses.
How_To_Improve: Cut unnecessary expenses. Focus on revenue. Automate before hiring.
Anti_Pattern: Not tracking burn because 'expenses are small'

Formula: Cash in Bank / Monthly Burn Rate
Why_It_Matters: How many months until cash runs out. THE survival metric.
How_To_Improve: Reduce burn (cut costs) OR increase revenue. Both ideally.
Anti_Pattern: Counting expected revenue as cash in bank

Why_It_Matters: Revenue minus direct costs of delivering product. SaaS should be 70%+.
How_To_Improve: Reduce hosting costs. Optimize infrastructure. Negotiate vendor pricing.
Anti_Pattern: Including team salaries in COGS (those are operating expenses)

Why_It_Matters: What you actually keep. Revenue minus ALL costs. Bootstrap goal: 20%+.
How_To_Improve: Control operating expenses. Automate before hiring. Focus on high-margin customers.
Anti_Pattern: Celebrating revenue growth while net margin is negative

Formula: (Customers Lost in Period / Customers at Start) × 100
Why_It_Matters: Percentage of customers leaving per month. #1 growth killer.
How_To_Improve: Improve onboarding. Add switching costs. Talk to churned customers.
Anti_Pattern: Ignoring churn because 'new signups replace them'

Why_It_Matters: Months to recover CAC. Shorter = more cash for growth.
How_To_Improve: Increase first-month revenue. Offer annual plans. Reduce CAC.
Anti_Pattern: Ignoring payback period while spending on growth

Formula: Total Revenue / Number of Full-Time Employees
Why_It_Matters: Efficiency metric. Giantiny ③ = maximize this number.
How_To_Improve: Automate before hiring. Invest in tools. Only hire when automation exhausted.
Anti_Pattern: Hiring to match competitor headcount instead of revenue efficiency
